freeze_terms.definition: The frozen object is the corpus DEFINITION and its LOCKS: the manifest (sources, slots, targets, notes, hashes, licences, evidence) at the sha256 above, and the per-slot coverage recorded above, as evidence in reports/.
freeze_terms.change_policy: Any change to the manifest (new source, new slot, licence change, re-pin, cleaner change that moves hashes) requires the founder's approval, is recorded as a new experiment, and produces corpus version v3 with its own freeze record. v2 is never edited in place.
freeze_terms.downstream_use: Tokenizer research stages (vocabulary sizing, pre-tokenization ablations, tokenizer-vs-tokenizer model experiments) train on the train split of this corpus and evaluate on its held-out split; they cite indic-tokenizer/v2 plus the manifest sha256.
freeze_terms.scope: This freeze covers the tokenizer-research corpus only. It is NOT a pretraining corpus (MASTER_CONTEXT section 10) and does not freeze the future FrontierCorpus v1 source inventory.
